title: GPU hash cracking
description: GPU-accelerated cracker. -m sets the hash mode (0=MD5, 100=SHA1, 1000=NTLM, 13100=Kerberoast, 18200=AS-REP). hashcat --help lists every mode.
output: Cracked hash:plaintext pairs; re-run with --show to list them.

title: Crack with John the Ripper
description: Auto-detects many hash types or force one with --format=. --list=formats shows all; --show prints cracked passwords.
output: Cracked passwords; run john hashes --show to review them.

title: Crack Linux shadow (unshadow)
description: Merge passwd + shadow into one file John understands, then crack. Add --wordlist=... for a custom list.

title: Crack Windows NT hashes
description: Crack dumped Windows NTLM hashes (e.g. from SAM or secretsdump) with the NT format.

title: Online brute force (any service)
description: Online password guessing across many protocols. -l user / -L users.txt, -P passwords, -t threads (higher is faster but louder), -s custom port, -W adds a delay to dodge WAF lockouts.
output: Valid login pairs for the target service.

title: Generate a wordlist
description: Builds wordlists by pattern/charset. Placeholders: @ lower, , upper, % digit, ^ special. Min/max lengths come first, -o writes the file.
output: A wordlist file matching your pattern (can get huge, mind the size).

title: Wordlist from a website
description: Spiders a site and builds a custom wordlist from its content; -m sets the minimum word length. Great for targeted password guessing.
output: A wordlist of site-specific terms to feed hydra/hashcat/john.

title: Compile & crack crypt() hashes
description: Ricardo Longatto's C brute-forcer for Linux crypt() hashes. Clone the repo, compile, run against a wordlist, then supply the full hash + salt. https://github.com/ricardolongatto/loncrack
output: The cracked password when the hash/salt matches a wordlist entry.
